observation.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i 's/^  caddy:\n    environment:/&/' .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p = '.devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("""  caddy:
    environment:""", """  caddy:
    image: caddy:2.11-alpine
    command:
      [
        'caddy',
        'run',
        '--config',
        '/etc/caddy/Caddyfile.local',
        '--adapter',
        'caddyfile',
      ]
    environment:""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml config --quiet && echo "COMPOSE FILE VALID"
